text: Corrects the AC19 claim, which used 37ms for the hook path. That is pawl pending; pawl hook claude-code completes in 5ms over repeated runs. The AC18 budget is twenty times the hook rather than three, so the case is stronger — but I reached for the nearest measured number rather than the right one, in a criterion added to replace a guess

verified_by.ref: measured 5ms for pawl hook claude-code over 3 runs
